title: SorryDB: Can AI Provers Complete Real-World Lean Theorems?
authors_zh: Austin Letson, Leopoldo Sarra, Auguste Poiroux, Oliver Dressler, Paul Lezeau, Dhyan Aranha, Frederick Pu, Aaron Hill, Miguel Corredera Hidalgo, Julian Berman, George Tsoukalas, Lenny Taelman
paper_type_zh: 动态更新的真实 Lean 证明任务基准
best_for_zh: 需要评测或训练面向真实 Lean 项目的证明智能体的研究者。
one_line: SorryDB continuously harvests open Lean proof obligations with pinned repository metadata so proposed proofs can be compiled in their original projects.
SorryDB 从真实 Lean 项目持续抽取待证明命题，并以固定提交、Lean 版本和编译复现信息构成可更新的证明任务库。
why: It exposes a rerunnable outcome-verification surface rather than a text-only reference answer.
inclusion_reason: The release pairs tasks with an executable or formal terminal verification contract.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Most Lean theorem-proving benchmarks consist of static competition problems or carefully curated small corpora, which differ substantially from the projects mathematicians maintain in practice. Static test sets are also vulnerable to training contamination, so high performance on benchmarks such as miniF2F does not establish that a prover can understand large dependency graphs, match project versions, and solve open obligations that matter to the community.

SorryDB asks how real project sorry statements can be collected continuously and evaluated inside their original repository environments. It turns unfinished Prop declarations from public Lean projects into reproducible tasks, requires a model to submit a replacement proof, and lets compilation in the original project determine whether the goal is actually closed.

主流 Lean 定理证明基准多来自静态竞赛题或经过整理的小型语料，与数学家日常维护的真实形式化项目差异明显。静态测试集还容易被训练语料污染，模型在 miniF2F 一类基准上的高分不能直接说明它能理解大型依赖、适配项目版本并完成社区真正留下的开放证明义务。

SorryDB 要回答的是如何持续收集真实项目中的 sorry，并在原仓库环境内公平评测证明器。它把公开 Lean 项目中的未完成 Prop 陈述转化为可复现任务流，要求模型提交替换证明，再由原项目编译器判断是否真正关闭目标。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The main contribution is a dynamically updated database of real-world Lean tasks together with public evaluation infrastructure. SorryDB monitors active projects indexed by Reservoir and extracts open proof obligations from 78 real formalization repositories. Its nightly database records repository URLs, branches, commits, Lean versions, source coordinates, and the information needed for local reproduction.

The paper evaluates a fixed snapshot, SorryDB_2601: the complete snapshot contains 2,601 sorry statements, with 1,000 selected for the public evaluation split. The project also releases the crawler, template agents, an independent compilation verifier, result formats, and a leaderboard, allowing the data to serve both as a dynamic benchmark and as training material for retrieval and repair agents operating in real Lean projects.

SorryDB 的主要贡献是一个动态更新的真实世界 Lean 任务数据库与公开评测基础设施。系统监控 Reservoir 中的活跃项目，从 78 个真实形式化仓库抽取开放证明义务；夜间数据库保存仓库地址、分支、commit、Lean 版本、文件坐标和本地复现所需信息。

论文评测使用固定快照 SorryDB_2601：完整快照含 2,601 个 sorry，其中抽取 1,000 题作为公开评测集。项目同时开放 crawler、模板 agent、独立编译 verifier、结果格式和排行榜，使数据既可作为动态 benchmark，也可用于训练面向真实 Lean 项目的检索与修复 agent。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Continuously crawl projects: Public Lean 4 repositories listed by Reservoir are cloned at specified branches and commits, and lake build is used to test reproducibility.
  1. Locate proof obligations: A Lean REPL scans Prop-valued declarations containing sorry, recording files, coordinates, namespaces, imports, Lean versions, and repository metadata. Projects that cannot be built reliably are excluded from evaluable data.
  1. Freeze evaluation snapshots: Timestamped snapshots are created from the nightly database, and a 1,000-task split is selected across projects and task properties so leaderboard results remain comparable as the live database changes.
  1. Generate and verify proofs: General LLMs, specialized provers, or agents submit Lean code replacing the sorry. An independent verifier recompiles it at the original commit with original dependencies, counting success only when the goal closes. Reproduction requires fixed snapshots, attempt budgets, and agent tool permissions.

1. 持续抓取项目： 从 Reservoir 列出的公开 Lean 4 仓库读取活跃版本，克隆指定 branch/commit，并运行 lake build 检查项目能否复现。
  1. 定位证明义务： 使用 Lean REPL 扫描 Prop 类型声明中的 sorry，记录文件、行列、命名空间、imports、Lean 版本和仓库元数据；无法稳定构建的项目不进入可评测集。
  1. 冻结评测快照： 从夜间数据库生成带时间戳的 snapshot，并按项目与任务特征抽取 1,000 题评测 split，避免排行榜随数据库更新而不可比较。
  1. 生成并验证证明： 通用 LLM、专用 prover 或 agent 提交替换 sorry 的 Lean 代码；独立 verifier 在原 commit 和依赖中重新编译，成功关闭目标才计为通过。复现需固定 snapshot、尝试次数和 agent 工具权限。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
On the fixed SorryDB_2601 evaluation, the strongest Gemini Flash agentic strategy reaches 30.3% Pass@1 over 1,000 tasks, while its self-correcting variant reaches 27.9%. A deterministic collection of Lean tactics obtains 8.4%, and Goedel-Prover V2 32B obtains 2.7% Pass@1. The union of all listed approaches solves only 35.7% of the tasks, indicating complementary capabilities and a large unsolved remainder.

These results support the claim that rankings on competition benchmarks do not transfer directly to real projects: general agents, one-shot LLMs, specialized provers, and simple tactics solve different obligations. However, the numbers depend on the January 2026 snapshot, context preparation, and attempt budgets and should not be treated as the permanent difficulty of the continuously changing database.

固定的 SorryDB_2601 评测显示，最强的 Gemini Flash agentic 方法在 1,000 题上达到 30.3% Pass@1，自纠错版本为 27.9%；作为对照，直接应用一组确定性 Lean tactics 得到 8.4%，Goedel-Prover V2 32B 的 Pass@1 为 2.7%。所有列出方法的并集只覆盖 35.7% 任务，说明系统能力互补且大量真实义务仍未解决。

这些数字支持“竞赛基准排名不能直接迁移到真实项目”：通用 agent、单轮 LLM、专用 prover 和简单 tactics 各自解决不同题目。但结果依赖 2026 年 1 月的固定快照、上下文准备方式和尝试预算，不能代表不断更新数据库的永久难度。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Existing formal benchmarks usually curate a set of theorems and keep it static for years, optimizing comparability on standardized mathematical problems. SorryDB changes both the source and lifecycle of tasks: it does not rewrite problems manually but continuously indexes genuine sorry statements from active repositories, treating commits, dependencies, and Lean versions as part of each task.

Its novelty is not compilation-based verification itself. It unifies temporal freshness, project realism, and original-environment reproduction in the benchmark contract. A system optimized for one leaderboard snapshot must still solve new community obligations appearing in later nightly snapshots, reducing static-test contamination and overfitting to competition-problem distributions.

已有形式化基准通常先整理一批 theorem，再多年保持不变；其目标是比较标准数学题上的证明成功率。SorryDB 改变的是任务来源和生命周期：它不人工改写题目，而是持续索引活跃仓库中真实留下的 sorry，并把 commit、依赖和 Lean 版本作为任务本体的一部分。

其新意也不是首次用编译器验证 Lean 证明，而是将“时间新鲜度、项目真实性和原环境复现”统一进 benchmark contract。模型若针对排行榜优化，面对后续夜间快照仍需解决新的社区任务，从而降低静态测试集污染和只适配竞赛题分布的风险。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Selection bias in sorry statements: Open obligations may be low-priority placeholders, difficult research questions, or engineering facts intentionally left unproved. They are not a random sample of mathematical community needs.
  1. High reproduction cost: The 78 projects use different Lean/Mathlib versions and local dependencies. Repository deletion, external-resource changes, or build-script drift can invalidate previously usable tasks.
  1. Tension between dynamics and comparability: Nightly data provides freshness, whereas leaderboards require fixed snapshots. Reusers must report the snapshot ID, commit, context truncation, attempt count, and whether retrieval or execution feedback is allowed.

1. sorry 分布有选择偏差： 开放的 sorry 可能是低优先级占位符、困难研究问题或暂不想证明的工程事实，不等同于数学社区随机抽样的需求。
  1. 环境复现成本高： 78 个项目使用不同 Lean/Mathlib 版本与本地依赖；仓库删除、外部资源变化或构建脚本漂移会使原本有效的任务失效。
  1. 动态与可比性冲突： 夜间数据适合新鲜度，排行榜必须使用固定 snapshot。复用时应同时报告 snapshot ID、commit、上下文裁剪、尝试数和是否允许检索或执行反馈。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Real-world prover evaluation: Use SorryDB_2601 or a later fixed snapshot to compare general models, specialized provers, and agents, reporting Pass@1/Pass@k, build-failure rates, and per-project results in original environments.
  1. Agent training: Record repository navigation, lemma retrieval, proof proposals, compiler errors, and revisions as trajectories, using successful goal closure as the terminal reward. Train/test splits must be separated by project and time to avoid repository leakage.
  1. Continuous regression testing: Run an internal Lean assistant against newly collected nightly tasks to measure capability drift after version upgrades. For research limited to independent competition theorems, SorryDB’s environment complexity may impose unnecessary cost.

1. 真实世界 prover 评测： 使用 SorryDB_2601 或后续固定快照比较通用模型、专用 prover 与 agent，在原项目中报告 Pass@1/Pass@k、构建失败率和按项目拆分结果。
  1. Agent 训练： 将仓库定位、相关 lemma 检索、候选证明、编译错误和修正动作记录为轨迹，用编译是否关闭目标提供终局奖励；训练/测试必须按项目和时间切分，避免同仓库泄漏。
  1. 持续回归测试： 对内部 Lean assistant 定期运行新夜间任务，观察版本升级后的能力漂移。若研究只关心独立、无依赖的竞赛题，SorryDB 的环境复杂度可能不是合适成本。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. One-sentence position: SorryDB turns open sorry statements from real Lean projects into a continuously updated task stream verified by compilation in original environments.
  2. Method takeaway: Crawl Reservoir repositories, build fixed commits, locate obligations through a Lean REPL, generate proofs, and recompile the original project.
  3. Data takeaway: It covers 78 projects; SorryDB_2601 contains 2,601 obligations, with 1,000 used for the paper evaluation.
  4. Evidence anchor: The strongest agent reaches 30.3% Pass@1, while the union of all methods solves only 35.7%, and specialized and general systems are complementary.
  5. Reuse decision: It is suitable for real-project theorem proving; environment drift is the largest risk, so snapshots, commits, and tool budgets must be fixed.

1. 一句话定位： SorryDB 把真实 Lean 项目中的开放 sorry 变成持续更新、原环境可编译验证的任务流。
  2. 方法抓手： 抓取 Reservoir 仓库、固定 commit 构建、Lean REPL 定位义务、模型补全证明、原项目重新编译。
  3. 数据抓手： 覆盖 78 个项目；SorryDB_2601 含 2,601 个义务，论文评测使用其中 1,000 个。
  4. 证据锚点： 最强 agent Pass@1 为 30.3%，所有方法并集仅解决 35.7%，且专用 prover 与通用模型互补。
  5. 复用决定： 适合真实项目 theorem proving；最大风险是环境漂移，必须固定 snapshot、commit 与工具预算。
